ITEM 1 | Pale off-white cubes with smooth, matte, slightly rubbery-looking surfaces and soft edges, about 2-3 cm per cube, roughly 7 pieces clustered on the upper-left of the plate, no visible browning or sheen | 110
ITEM 2 | Fresh dark green leaves with flat, broad blades and visible central stems, slightly glossy and limp, spread across the upper-center of the plate, covering roughly 12% of the plate | 35
ITEM 3 | Dark green florets with small, tightly clustered heads and thin stalks, dull matte finish, sitting among the leaves near the center, about 3-4 cm across | 20
ITEM 4 | Thin reddish-purple onion-like slivers and small pieces, moist and slightly translucent, scattered among the greens at the center | 5
ITEM 5 | Golden-brown potato wedges and chunks with irregular cut edges, dry-looking crisp surfaces with browned, slightly speckled skin, about 3-5 cm pieces, four pieces on the upper-right of the plate | 130
ITEM 6 | Baked rectangular portion with bright orange-red tomato-colored sauce topped by a layer of melted pale cheese, showing golden-brown blistered spots and charred edges, slightly oily sheen, sitting on a flat crust-like base, about 8 x 6 cm, centered lower on the plate | 150
ITEM 7 | Dark purple-black eggplant pieces with charred, slightly wrinkled skin and some lighter browned interior flesh visible on cut faces, roughly 2-3 cm chunks, clustered on the lower-right edge of the plate | 45
ITEM 8 | Small golden-brown cubes or chunks with grilled, browned surfaces and cut edges, about 2 cm, lying among the eggplant pieces on the lower-right | 20
